thought: Paralyzed at 11. Paralympic gold medalist twice over.
support: A car accident in 2012 left Avani Lekhara paralyzed below the waist at age 11. Inspired by a gift of Abhinav Bindra's autobiography from her father, she took up shooting in 2015. At the Tokyo Paralympics, she became the first Indian woman to win a Paralympic gold medal, setting a then-world-record score of 249.6 in the 10m air rifle standing event, and also won bronze in 50m rifle 3 positions. At Paris 2024, she defended her title with a new record score of 249.7 - making her only the second Indian athlete ever, after javelin thrower Devendra Jhajharia, to win two Paralympic gold medals.
